name: element
title: Add DOM Element
description: Adds a native DOM element inside a resolved component target. Defaults to adding a div inside the highest-level rendered DOM element and can target one or all matching data-area or element nodes while optionally assigning a class.

settings.name: component
settings.title: Component
settings.description: Optional React component name used to resolve its source file and scope edits to that component.

settings.name: file
settings.title: File
settings.description: Optional source file. May be absolute or project-relative.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Path
settings.description: Optional project-relative source file path alias.

settings.name: seat_id
settings.title: Construction Seat ID
settings.description: Optional exact data-rab-seat address for the DOM target. This is an internal construction address; human requests may resolve to it semantically.

settings.name: data_area
settings.title: Parent Data Area
settings.description: Optional data-area value identifying the parent DOM target.

settings.name: element
settings.title: Parent DOM Element
settings.description: Optional parent native DOM element name.

settings.name: quantifier
settings.title: How Many Parents
settings.description: Defaults to one parent. Use all to add the child to every matching parent.

settings.name: tag
settings.title: New Element
settings.description: Native element tag to add. Defaults to div.

settings.name: class_name
settings.title: Class
settings.description: Optional class token(s) placed on the new element.

settings.name: new_data_area
settings.title: New Data Area
settings.description: Optional data-area value placed on the new element.

settings.name: new_seat_id
settings.title: New Construction Seat ID
settings.description: Optional data-rab-seat address to place on the new/wrapper element so later Tools can target it exactly.

settings.name: dry_run
settings.title: Preview Only
settings.description: Return the deterministic edit plan without writing the file.
